text:
sara_ops: deploybot started v2 -> eu pool-3. ops dash showing 422s on /v2/stream. can we pause? :eyes:

deploybot: roll rb-1767800001 at 10% -> pool-3. alert: error_rate(/v2/stream)=6.4% (threshold=1%).

anna_prodeng: quick traces show truncated stream frames for very long contexts (>6k tokens). sample: `Error: invalid_chunk_size at chunk 42`.

jon_sre: sounds like chunked-transfer parsing mismatch with older edge proxies. any tenant correlation?

sara_ops: top affected tenants: 4321, 7788. pausing pool-3 now: `deploybot pause rb-1767800001 --pool pool-3`.

deploybot: pause acknowledged for pool-3; rollout halted for that pool.

mike_release: decision time: rollback or pin tenants to v1 while we patch? Need comms + release notes update.

anna_prodeng: proposed short-term fix: flip runtime to legacy chunker for long contexts. can build hotpatch in ~30-45m.

jon_sre: hotpatch ok, but pinning gives immediate protection. recommend pin tenants 4321,7788 to v1 during patch.

sara_ops: pinning: `deploybot pin-tenant 4321 --api v1` `deploybot pin-tenant 7788 --api v1`.

deploybot: tenants 4321, 7788 pinned to v1 (cfg id cfg-7a9b1c).

kate_pm: drafting customer note: "We paused EU v2 streaming rollout due to a long-session chunking issue. You're pinned to v1 while we deploy a fix. No action needed."

mike_release: include ETA: hotpatch in 30-45m, verification 20-30m, then unpin & resume. add status link.

anna_prodeng: running canary smoke once build finishes. will post canary hostnames and checksum.

sara_ops: ops checklist: monitor invalid_chunk_size logs, watch error_rate and synthetic long-context clients. ready to unpin after green.

jon_sre: canary smoke looks clean so far (0/200 invalid_chunk_size). standing by for promote.

anna_prodeng: promoting hotpatch to pool-3 staged rollout.

sara_ops: metrics back to baseline. unpinning tenants now. `deploybot unpin-tenant 4321` `deploybot unpin-tenant 7788`.

deploybot: tenants unpinned. rollback option remains if anything regresses.

kate_pm: release notes updated with known issue and mitigation; docs PR created.

mike_release: follow-ups: add long-context synthetic to preflight and regression test for chunker boundaries. assigning to anna_prodeng + jon_sre.

sara_ops: closing thread. good job team.
